name: 10166 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10166 (New York) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10166 (New York) has 12 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
